title: No-sew T-shirt tote bag
title_ar: حقيبة تسوق من قميص دون خياطة
summary: Cut off the sleeves and neckline and knot the hem: a washable shopping bag in twenty minutes.
summary_ar: قصّ الأكمام وفتحة الرقبة واعقد الحافة السفلية: حقيبة تسوق قابلة للغسل في عشرين دقيقة.
result: a tote bag made from a T-shirt: sleeves and neckline cut away to form handles, the bottom hem cut into fringe strips tied in tight knots
steps_outline: Lay the shirt flat and smooth it out
Cut off both sleeves just inside the seams
Cut a wide scoop around the neckline to form the bag opening
Cut 8 cm fringe strips along the bottom through both layers
Tie each front strip to the back strip below it with a double knot, then knot neighbouring pairs to close gaps
safety: Use sharp fabric scissors and keep fingers clear of the blades

title: Braided T-shirt yarn coasters
title_ar: قواعد أكواب مضفورة من خيوط القمصان
summary: T-shirt fabric cut into stretchy yarn, braided and coiled, makes soft washable coasters.
summary_ar: قماش القميص المقطّع إلى خيوط مطاطية ومضفور وملفوف يصنع قواعد أكواب ناعمة قابلة للغسل.
result: four round coasters coiled from thick braids of the same cotton jersey fabric, stitched flat, stacked beside a mug
steps_outline: Cut the body of the shirt into a continuous 2 cm strip in a spiral
Pull the strip so it curls into round yarn
Braid three strands tightly
Coil the braid flat from the centre outwards
Stitch through the coils on the back every few centimetres and tuck the end in
safety: Keep needles in a pincushion, not loose on the table

title: Reusable cleaning cloths
summary: Worn cotton cut into squares replaces paper towels for dusting, polishing and spills.
summary_ar: القطن المهترئ المقطّع إلى مربعات يحلّ محل المناديل الورقية للتنظيف والتلميع ومسح الانسكابات.
result: a neat stack of square cleaning cloths cut from the same cotton fabric, folded on a kitchen counter
steps_outline: Wash the garment and cut away seams, buttons and zips
Mark 25 cm squares and cut them out
Stack them in a basket by the sink
Wash them with towels after use
safety: Do not use cloths used with bleach or oven cleaner on food surfaces afterwards

title: Denim pocket wall organizer
summary: Back pockets cut from old jeans and stitched to a denim panel hold mail, remotes or craft tools on a wall.
summary_ar: جيوب خلفية مقصوصة من جينز قديم ومخيطة على لوح من الجينز تحفظ البريد أو أجهزة التحكم أو أدوات الحرف على الحائط.
result: a rectangle of blue denim hanging from a wooden stick, with four back pockets from the same jeans stitched on in two rows, holding letters and pencils
extra_materials: a wooden dowel or straight stick
steps_outline: Cut a large rectangle from the legs for the backing panel
Cut the back pockets out, leaving 1 cm of fabric around each
Arrange the pockets in rows and pin them
Stitch around the sides and bottom of each pocket
Fold the top edge over the stick, stitch a channel and tie twine to hang it
safety: Denim is thick: push the needle with a thimble, not your fingertip

title: Denim workshop apron
summary: The legs of two pairs of jeans become a hard-wearing apron, with the original back pockets kept for tools.
summary_ar: ساقا زوجين من الجينز يصبحان مريلة متينة مع الإبقاء على الجيوب الخلفية الأصلية للأدوات.
result: a sturdy blue denim apron with visible seams, two original jeans back pockets on the front and long denim ties
steps_outline: Unpick or cut open the leg seams and press the panels flat with an iron
Cut and sew panels together into an apron shape using a paper template
Cut the back pockets out with a margin and sew them on the front
Hem all raw edges with a double fold
Sew on a neck strap and waist ties cut from the leftover legs
safety: Keep fingers away from the needle and unplug the machine when changing needles
Rest the iron upright and switch it off when you step away

title: Knotted rag rug
summary: Fabric strips knotted through a mesh base make a soft, colorful rug that uses up a whole bag of scraps.
summary_ar: شرائط القماش المعقودة عبر قاعدة شبكية تصنع سجادة ناعمة ملونة تستهلك كيسًا كاملًا من القصاصات.
result: a rectangular shaggy rug made of hundreds of short knotted fabric strips in mixed colors, lying on a wooden floor
extra_materials: rug canvas or a sturdy mesh (such as an old non-slip mat)
a crochet hook or bent wire to pull strips
steps_outline: Cut the fabric into strips about 3 x 12 cm
Sort strips into colors and plan a simple stripe or border
Push a strip through one hole and back up through the next
Tie a single knot and tug it tight
Work row by row until the mesh is covered, then trim uneven ends
safety: Put a non-slip pad under the finished rug on smooth floors

title: Patchwork cushion cover
title_ar: غطاء وسادة من قطع القماش المرقّعة
summary: Squares from favourite shirts and scraps sewn together make a cushion cover with an envelope back.
summary_ar: مربعات من القمصان المفضلة والقصاصات المخيطة معًا تصنع غطاء وسادة بظهر على شكل ظرف.
result: a square cushion covered in a patchwork of nine fabric squares in coordinated colors and prints, on a sofa
steps_outline: Cut nine equal squares, adding 1 cm seam allowance on each side
Sew squares into three rows, then join the rows, pressing seams with an iron
Cut two back panels that overlap by 10 cm and hem the overlapping edges
Place the back panels face down on the front and sew around the edge
Turn it right side out through the envelope opening and insert the cushion
safety: Rest the iron upright between uses and switch it off when you finish

title: Fabric-scrap draught stopper
title_ar: سدّادة تيار هواء للباب من القصاصات
summary: A tube of fabric stuffed with scraps lies along the door to keep cool air in and dust out.
summary_ar: أنبوب من القماش محشو بالقصاصات يوضع أسفل الباب ليحفظ الهواء البارد ويمنع دخول الغبار.
result: a long soft fabric tube made from a jeans leg, stuffed full and tied at both ends, lying along the bottom of a door
extra_materials: fabric scraps or old clothes for stuffing
steps_outline: Measure the width of the door
Cut a jeans leg or sew a fabric tube to that length plus 10 cm
Sew one end closed
Stuff it firmly with cut-up scraps
Sew the other end closed
safety: Keep it clear of heaters and clean it regularly so dust does not build up

title: Drawstring produce bags
summary: Light cotton sewn into drawstring bags replaces plastic produce bags at the market.
summary_ar: قطن خفيف مخيط في أكياس برباط يحل محل الأكياس البلاستيكية لشراء الخضار والفاكهة.
result: three light cotton drawstring bags made from the same fabric, one filled with oranges and one with onions
extra_materials: a safety pin to thread the cord
steps_outline: Wash the fabric and cut two 30 x 35 cm rectangles per bag
Fold and stitch a 2 cm channel along the top of each piece
Sew the pieces together around three sides, stopping below the channel
Thread twine through the channel with a safety pin
Knot the ends and turn the bag right side out
safety: Use clean fabric that has never held chemicals or cleaning products
